claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Terbutaline, a beta-2 adrenergic receptor agonist, is not expected to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would likely be weak and mediated by cAMP signaling or off-target adrenergic effects rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
